trigger: A visible unattended item is in an applicable attack's range
choices: Stable IDs 4–5 issued melee weapons, 6–7 bows, 8–9 deployed caltrops, 10–11 armor, 12–13 shields; gear carried or worn is not directly selectable in the arena

rule_source: https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.pdf#page=178 · Object AC, HP and damage type rulings
trigger: A weapon or hazard cluster takes damage
choices: Steel AC 19; wooden bows and staff AC 15; resilient tiny dagger/cluster 5 HP; resilient small weapons 10 HP; poison/psychic immunity; arena grants metal piercing resistance and wood fire vulnerability

rule_source: https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.pdf#page=178 · Burning Hazard; SRD pp. 131–132 Fireball and Fire Bolt
trigger: Flammable unattended gear is ignited by a qualifying effect
choices: The arena assigns burning objects to their original issue holder's turn for deterministic initiative; picking up a burning item does not extinguish it

trigger: A deployed caltrops cluster receives damage
choices: An abstract five-foot cluster counts as a resilient tiny steel object; destruction removes the whole cluster and does not refund the bag

rule_source: Arena terrain adjudication; SRD 5.2 p. 178 Breaking Objects
trigger: Attempt to damage a structural wall, roof or floor
choices: Wall segments are permanent solid stone in the arena contract; fighting can alter unattended equipment and deployed hazards

trigger: A dropped wooden bow or staff is destroyed by one blunt/cutting hit without earlier burning
cost: Repair spell timing is handled by the Mending caster
choices: Retain repairable fragments at their exact drop point; restore the weapon with pre-fracture wear; burn, metal dents, and force destruction do not leave repairable fragments

trigger: A selected spell area reaches unattended gear, from its point of origin
choices: Ignite flammable objects for Fireball without applying its creature damage; apply full Thunder to unattended nonmagical objects for Shatter

trigger: Body armor or shield dropped or displaced onto a surface
choices: Stable IDs 10–11 body armor and 12–13 shields; leather treated like heavy cloth (AC 11), metal AC 19, Small wooden shields AC 15. Armor HP 18, shield HP 10. Wood/leather ignites and has Fire vulnerability
